query:
// Site servers (active + passive) for the same site, relayable over SMB
MATCH (g:Group)-[:SCCM_CoerceAndRelayToSMB]-(a:Computer)-[:SCCM_AssignAllPermissions]->(s:SCCM_Site)
WHERE a.SMBSigningRequired = false
  AND ('SMS Site Server@' + s.siteCode) IN a.SCCMSiteSystemRoles
// require the site to actually have 2+ site-server hosts (i.e. a passive exists)
WITH g, a, s
MATCH (srv:Computer)
WHERE ('SMS Site Server@' + s.siteCode) IN srv.SCCMSiteSystemRoles
WITH g, a, s, count(DISTINCT srv) AS siteServers
WHERE siteServers >= 2
MATCH p = (g)-[:SCCM_CoerceAndRelayToSMB]-(a)-[:SCCM_AssignAllPermissions]->(s)
RETURN p
name: SCCM Hierarchy TAKEOVER-7
description: NTLM coercion and relay to SMB between primary and passive site servers
